answer_1.quote: We consider T5 v1.1 , which was pretrained in an unsupervised way only, unlike the original T5 . In the case of FEVER and NATURAL QUESTIONS, following  and  respectively, we consider a closed-book setting where models should rely solely on its parametric knowledge, and report performances on dev sets as test sets are private. To measure performances, we use accuracy for FEVER and MULTIPIT Id , F1 for WLP, STANCEOSAURUS, and NATURAL QUESTIONS, and BERT-iBLEU  (i.e., the harmonic mean of self-BLEU and BERTSCORE ) for MULTIPIT Gen .
answer_1.outputs: The target is a paraphrased sentence for MULTIPIT Gen and the answer to the question for NATURAL QUESTIONS.
